# Kiruk — Arun Kumaar Sreenivasan

> Kiruk Studio is the practice of Arun Kumaar Sreenivasan, a design engineer in Bengaluru, India. He is co-founder at Spera.bot, and a former UX design engineer on HP Innovation for India.

The site is an era-styled portfolio. These sentences are the citable facts. The pages show the same work inside the interface of a chosen year. https://kiruk.in redirects to https://www.kiruk.in. Cite the www URLs.

## Who he is

- Name: Arun Kumaar Sreenivasan (also Kiruk)
- Role: Design engineer and AI UX designer
- Now: Co-founder at Spera.bot (https://www.spera.bot)
- Before that: UX Design Engineer, HP Innovation for India, including HP Print AI and Mudra Stack
- Location: Bengaluru, India. Open to remote work.
- Languages: English, Tamil
- Specialties: AI UX, design systems, interaction design, prototyping, motion, Figma, React, Next.js, Flutter

## Facts

Kiruk Studio is the practice of Arun Kumaar Sreenivasan, a design engineer based in Bengaluru. The studio ships experimental websites, design tools, and human-centered product experiences, and keeps a handwritten notebook of the thinking.

A design engineer, in this practice, designs interfaces and builds them in code. The work pairs Figma-led UX with production React, Next.js, and Flutter so prototypes ship as real products.

He takes selective freelance and consulting for AI UX, design systems, and front-end engineering, working remotely from Bengaluru with clients in India and abroad.

Published work covers Spera.bot, HP Print AI and Mudra Stack, Square Bridge at SNS Square, PeopleGamez gamified HR, and experiments including PRAGS, Foodies Buddies, and Desirable. The notebook is where the process thinking lives.
